outcome: Third-grade math and reading test scores
cohort: 6393 children of nulliparous women born at 39 weeks of gestation or later who completed third-grade math and reading tests
finding: Induction of labor at 39 or 40 weeks of gestation in nulliparous women was not associated with differences in third-grade math or reading test scores or proficiency compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: This study investigates the association between labor induction at 39 or 40 weeks and childhood cognitive outcomes compared to expectant management.
